### Unceasing Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/unceasing-prayer
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 5:17
Points:
- Scripture commands unceasing prayer as a vital means of grace in the believer's walk.
- Maintaining consistent prayer habits is often difficult, leading many to neglect communion with God.
- Praying through the Psalms offers an inspired biblical structure for both private and corporate petitions.
- Practical frameworks like the ACTS model help orient daily prayer toward God's character and kingdom.

### Finding Gratitude in the Midst of Difficulties
Author: Susan Aken
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/finding-gratitude-in-the-midst-of-difficulties.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 5:16-18
Points:
- God commands believers to cultivate joy, prayer, and gratitude in every circumstance.
- Difficult trials and frightening diagnoses easily pull our focus toward fear and suffering.
- Intentionally listing daily blessings helps shift attention back to God's love and faithfulness.
- The gift of salvation through Christ provides an unfailing reason to give thanks in all seasons.
